info.name: DiffusionGemma System One (vLLM v0.34.0)
info.description: Structured decisions from DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B on vLLM: /v1/systemone (text, documents, images) and /v1/decisions. Images are base64 data URLs because the server has no internet access. Answers: noul -> {noul: p(yes)}, choice -> {choice, probabilities, confidence}, score -> {score (expected index), legend, probabilities}. Short single-word labels work best.

exec: for (const [k, a] of Object.entries(r.answers)) out[k] = a.choice ?? (a.type === 'noul' ? (a.noul > 0.5) : a.score);
